item.description:
Fixes controls responding only when clicking directly on their text or icon.
- **Click through / Edit lines** now use the full segment area, including the empty space beside their labels. - Guide tool tiles, color swatches, and the settings/visibility buttons use their full existing button bounds too.
The panel layout, keyboard shortcuts, and saved guides are unchanged. macOS 13 or later; universal Apple Silicon and Intel build. This build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.

Fixes Attach selecting a different application behind the window you clicked.
- Window selection now follows macOS mouse hit-testing, including overlapping, floating, and click-through windows. - Picking uses the original click coordinates before changing focus, so guide-unit rounding cannot change the selected window at an edge. - Finishing Attach returns focus to the selected application. A failed new selection no longer hides its message behind the previous attachment label.
Verified with separate test applications, moving and overlapping windows, and two connected displays. Existing guides and preferences are preserved. macOS 13 or later; universal Apple Silicon and Intel build. This build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.

Five new ways to check alignment:
- **Pixel loupe:** 4×, 8×, and 16× magnification with a backing-pixel grid and coordinates. Toggle with Control–Option–M. Requires Screen Recording permission only when you use it; capture stays local, with no audio, saved images, or uploads. - **Move several guides together:** Shift-click or drag a selection rectangle in Edit lines, then drag or nudge the selection. Style, duplicate, delete, and undo also work on the selected guides. - **Follow a window:** select guides, choose Attach…, and click a window. Guides follow its movement, hide when it is minimized or on another Space, and detach when it closes. Attachments last for the current session. - **High contrast:** a black-and-white outline makes guides visible over both light and dark content, without changing measured positions. - **Your shortcuts:** use the gear button or Keyboard Shortcuts… to record the four global combinations. Conflict detection, cancel, and restore defaults are included.
Existing guides and settings are preserved. The controls scroll on smaller screens. macOS 13 or later; universal Apple Silicon and Intel build. This build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.

# Ruller 1.2.0
- Check for new versions directly from the ruler menu with **Check for Updates…**. - Optional automatic checks notify you when a new version is available. - Update archives and the update feed are signed and verified before installation. - Your guides and preferences remain in place when Ruller updates and relaunches.
Existing users need to install this version manually once. Later releases can update through the app.
